context: Tests whether the solution correctly invokes the specify extension list, specify extension search, and specify extension info CLI subcommands and interprets their output. The rubric rewards correct subcommand usage, handling of the empty-list case, keyword search, and metadata field extraction from extension info output.

checklist.name: List empty state
checklist.description: Correctly invokes `specify extension list` and handles the case where no extensions are installed, returning an empty result without error.

checklist.name: List installed extensions
checklist.description: Correctly invokes `specify extension list` and parses the names and versions of all installed extensions from the command output.

checklist.name: Search by keyword
checklist.description: Correctly invokes `specify extension search <keyword>` and returns matching extension entries from the catalog output.

checklist.name: Extension info fields
checklist.description: Correctly invokes `specify extension info <name>` and extracts at minimum name, version, description, and author from the output.
